result.title: Exposing AI Inference as a Telco Network API over the 5G User Plane
result.comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the IEEE Future Networks World Forum 2026 (Portugal)
result.summary: Supporting edge Artificial Intelligence (AI) inference as a network service is challenging because current mobile systems can transport tensors but do not expose or understand the inference context that gives those tensors operational meaning. Prior studies have addressed this gap through dynamic partitioning, collaborative inference, and split pipelines; however, these solutions remain application-bound, network-blind, or context-free. This work proposes Inference on Demand (IoD), an inference-on-demand abstraction that exposes split inference through a CAMARA-like Application Program Interface (API) and carries a split-aware tensor context in-band across the 5G user plane path. We evaluate the IoD on a programmable user plane function (UPF)-based testbed using a partitionable visual AI workload, showing that adaptive split selection can operate as a network-facing service while avoiding the rigid cost profile of static configurations. Including our findings, split inference becomes more than offloading when the service intent, runtime partitioning, and tensor transport are made visible to the mobile data plane. This opens a path toward network-native AI services, in which programmable telco infrastructure coordinates computation, context, and connectivity for user-facing applications.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Inference on Demand（IoD），把 split inference 抽象为类 CAMARA 的网络 API，并在 5G 用户面随路承载 split-aware tensor context；在基于可编程 UPF 的测试床上以可切分视觉 AI 负载验证自适应切分选择，避免静态配置的固定成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 其自适应切分体现了通信—计算权衡下的动态计算分配，可能为 LVR 中动态计算预算、停止决策与真实成本建模提供类比，但全文不涉及 latent 推理状态或视觉证据筛选，需核查借鉴可行性。
